remarks: Welcome to 9 Creek Ridge—a rare opportunity to own a private, wooded 5-acre lot in a private community. Nestled within the serene and sought-after Creek Ridge development, this parcel offers the perfect blend of seclusion and convenience, located just minutes from the vibrant Village of Ellicottville and premier skiing at both Holiday Valley and HoliMont. Whether you're dreaming of building a cozy seasonal retreat or a full-time mountain escape, this scenic lot provides a peaceful, natural setting with mature trees, rolling terrain, and abundant wildlife. Enjoy four seasons of recreation right at your doorstep—skiing, hiking, biking, and more—all while being tucked away in a private location. Don’t miss your chance to create your dream home in the heart of Ellicottville’s outdoor paradise.
